text_block_list.text:
I remember, a long time ago, a friend
and I used
to play pretend cafe. That's
why... I...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Damn it! Still can't find it... I just can't
solve it...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Now every little thing is starting to
get on
my nerves. Even looking at this
scenery...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that was close!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
Oops, sorry! I'm in a rush, so smell you
later!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, what a pesky brat.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Was there always a cafe around
here?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Well, maybe I could use a caffeine
boost.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Welcome.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Cafe? You work part-time here?
Actually, never
mind that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The exterior was strange enough, but
the interior
is just as disorderly and
chaotic.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, I can't stand the slightest
fluctuation
today. Honestly, what is
wrong with my brain...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'll pour you... a cup of coffee.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Here you are.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's this, latte art? What a complete
waste of
effort. I didn't—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...This pattern. Is it a fractal?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It ripples and turns... without end... in
complete
unity... and beauty...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The sea...
Yeah... That's what I came
here for.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The winds and waves are peaceful now,
but
they're going to get worse later.
Such a shame...
The weather's so nice at
the moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The weather's... nice?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The weather is simply a matter of
phenomena.
There's nothing "good" or
"bad" about it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's just humans ascribing their own
values to the
Earth's natural systems.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Perhaps we shouldn't force our
own
values... onto the matters of this
world.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
We should... just let everything be as it
is. We just
have to feel... and observe.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, all we gotta do is watch. Forcing
our
preconceived notions onto reality
distorts our
understanding.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...That's it! It was so obvious... There's no
need to
analyze phenomena from my
personal bias.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Geez, the answer was practically
starin' at
me in the face.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I'm looking forward to your next visit. I
will have
a special brew ready... just for
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the
shopping
district, I spot Air Shakur
standing in an empty
plot.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Well... I was... just at that cafe
over—
choice_data_list: こんなところで何してるの？
choice_data_list_en: What are you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What the?! Where'd it go?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I guess I... Yeah... I was just out here
walking laps
on an empty plot of land.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's... really weird.
